# Draft:Tribal Wars 2

Tribal Wars 2, is an MMO medival strategy game, a sequel to the original, Tribal Wars developed by Inno Games, it is a browser game, released on September 2nd, 2014.
History
Tribal Wars 2 was announced in late 2013, with testing phases in 2014, and finally getting released in early September of 2014.
